definitions.explanation: Being behind in development or progress.

examples.japanese: {電車|でんしゃ}に5{分|ふん}の{遅|おく}れが{出|で}ている。
examples.english: The train is running 5 minutes late.

examples.japanese: {雪|ゆき}のせいで{飛行機|ひこうき}に{大|おお}きな{遅|おく}れが{出|で}ている。
examples.english: Flights are experiencing major delays because of the snow.

examples.japanese: {技術|ぎじゅつ}の{遅|おく}れを{取|と}り{戻|もど}す。
examples.english: To catch up on the technological lag.

examples.japanese: {勉強|べんきょう}の{遅|おく}れを{取|と}り{戻|もど}すために{毎日|まいにち}{頑張|がんば}っている。
examples.english: I'm working hard every day to make up for falling behind in my studies.

notes:
{遅|おく}れ is the noun form of {遅|おく}れる (to be late).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {遅|おく}れが{出|で}る (a delay occurs)
- {遅|おく}れを{取|と}る (to fall behind)
- {遅|おく}れを{取|と}り{戻|もど}す (to make up for lost time)
- 〜{分|ふん}の{遅|おく}れ (~ minutes' delay)

RELATED VERB:
- {遅|おく}れる: to be late, to be delayed
